name: Rakuen
source: Itsuki, a school student, is obsessed with his young beautiful math teacher Ryouko to the point of making look-a-like figurine of her. One day, he obtains a photo of Ryouko secretly masturbating in school infirmary...
translation: 学生伊树对年轻漂亮的数学老师凉子着迷，甚至制作了一个与她相似的雕像。有一天，他得到了一张凉子在学校医务室偷偷自慰的照片……
